tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are organizing a team-building retreat for the whole class. You have found a suitable resort for the event and need to contact the resort manager, Ms. Taylor, to discuss the reservation details. Write an email to Ms. Taylor.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the retreat and why you chose this particular resort.
Ask about the special dietary options offered.
Inquire about the recreational activities offered at the resort.
tasks.subject: Team-building Retreat Resort Inquiry
